summary: PEDEVCO Corp. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a Second Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement with Citibank and other lenders. The amendment modifies EBITDAX definitions, borrowing base redetermination scheduling, and reserve report delivery timelines. No price per share, premium, stake, or transaction value is mentioned. The filing describes a routine credit facility modification, not a special situation like an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. As a purely operational debt agreement amendment, it does not trigger a special-situations categorization.
